test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average monthly pocket money of Ram and Shyam is ₹2,460, Shyam and Manohar is ₹2,380 and Manohar and Ram is ₹2,760. Find the monthly pocket money of Ram alone.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In cyclic average problems like this, the sum of all individuals is equal to the sum of the given averages.

Sum (Ram + Shyam + Manohar) = 2,460 + 2,380 + 2,760 = 7,600

Ram = (Ram + Shyam + Manohar) − (Shyam + Manohar)

Ram = 7,600 − (2,380 × 2) = 7,600 − 4,760 = 2,840

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Average pocket money of Ram and Shyam = ₹2,460

Average pocket money of Shyam and Manohar = ₹2,380

Average pocket money of Manohar and Ram = ₹2,760

Formula: Sum = Average × Number of items

 
 R + S = 4920
 
 
 S + M = 4760
 
 
 M + R = 5520
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 Total Sum
 7600
 
 Ram = 7600 − 4760
 = 2840

⇒ Ram + Shyam = 2,460 × 2 = 4,920 --- (1)

⇒ Shyam + Manohar = 2,380 × 2 = 4,760 --- (2)

⇒ Manohar + Ram = 2,760 × 2 = 5,520 --- (3)

⇒ Adding (1), (2), and (3):

⇒ 2(Ram + Shyam + Manohar) = 4,920 + 4,760 + 5,520 = 15,200

⇒ Ram + Shyam + Manohar = 15,200 ÷ 2 = 7,600 --- (4)

⇒ Ram = (Ram + Shyam + Manohar) − (Shyam + Manohar)

⇒ Ram = 7,600 − 4,760

⇒ Ram = 2,840

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum and Average Relation

Total sum of items = Average × Number of items. For two people, Sum = Average × 2.

Cyclic Averages Property

When averages of pairs (A+B, B+C, C+A) are given, the sum of the three individuals (A+B+C) is equal to the sum of the three pairwise averages.

Weighted Average

When combining groups, the combined average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

3d:T
